Spalvos

Tailwind v4 playground — every class below is a spalvos token.

A transportable color system. Click any swatch to copy its code. Toggle the theme and contrast — the semantic tokens repoint, no class changes.

Palette

Six accent hues plus a warm neutral ink, each shown at its 500 anchor (the ink at its 1000 floor).

Surface

Six shades of paper, from the white of a card down to the frame the app sits in — each a touch deeper than the last.

Steps

Each family runs a 13-step ramp built in OKLCH — hue holds, chroma crests at 500, every step inside the sRGB gamut.

Example UI

The semantic tokens assembled into one card — the trend line rides the brand blue; the dots give the rest of the palette a job.
